sam_infra: FYI customers reported a preview token spike overnight on embeddings-heavy tenants after we enabled adaptive sampling. Preview estimates are ~1.9x final. suspect double-apply of sample_weight + retry replays.

rachel_sre: alerted via the metering healthcard. i'm seeing repeated request_ids with different x-client-retry-of headers = null. looks like some SDKs are re-issuing new request ids on retries.

mina_billing: That will break our dedupe. Current ledger dedupe uses request_id as the canonical key. two immediate choices: (A) require SDKs to populate x-client-retry-of on retries, or (B) add server-side dedupe fingerprint as fallback.

carlos_api: SDK change will take weeks for full rollout. fallback fingerprint seems pragmatic. proposal: compute fingerprint = sha256(tenant_id + "|" + model + "|" + trunc(prompt_sha256, 16)). store fingerprint in raw events and use COALESCE(request_id, headers->>'x-client-retry-of', fingerprint) as dedupe_key.

tasha_product: UX request: console cards must make it clear when numbers are sampled vs final. show a small badge "est." and expose sample_rate + dedupe_basis on hover. customers keep asking why previews drift.

sam_infra: implementation caveats: computing prompt_sha256 on ingest for every event will raise CPU costs on hot path. i recommend computing fingerprint only when tokens > 750 OR tenant flag `metering_fingerprint_opt_in=true`. otherwise enrich async and mark dedupe_basis=async_fingerprint_pending.

mina_billing: agreed. we'll accept dedupe_basis values: request_id | x-client-retry-of | fingerprint | pending. ledger ingestion already accepts an opaque dedupe_basis string, so provenance can travel to invoices.

carlos_api: also found a race in the preview scaler: sample_weight multiply happens in both router and preview-agg when a route annotation is applied. patch: consolidate sampling to aggregator side (single point) and make router only tag sample_rate. minimal change for canary.

rachel_sre: rollout plan suggestion: canary to 3 tenants (low, med, high) at 2% traffic, monitor metric `metering.preview_estimate_ratio{route="embeddings"}` alert if >1.25 for 15m. then 10% for 1h, then 50%.

sam_infra: adding runbook: 1) abort if preview_estimate_ratio > 1.3, 2) if abort, flip ingest shim to passthrough sample_rate and disable fingerprint fallback, 3) run backfill to recompute estimates, 4) notify billing and product.

mina_billing: SQL sketch to rollup with fingerprint fallback (pseudo):
```
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) AS dedupe_key
  FROM raw_metering
  WHERE ingest_day = current_date
)
SELECT tenant_id, dedupe_key, SUM(tokens) * (1.0 / NULLIF(sample_rate,0)) AS est_tokens
FROM raw
GROUP BY tenant_id, dedupe_key;
```

carlos_api: note NULLIF to avoid division by zero when sample_rate==0 (full sampling). also we'll add a route_tag field so we can scope dedupe behavior per-route.

tasha_product: console changes: add "Sampling provenance" column to the preview table. show why value chosen (request_id vs fingerprint) and a confidence score (high if request_id present, medium if x-client-retry-of, low if fingerprint).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/metering-shim v2.0 -> staging (owner: sam_infra) :rocket:

rachel_sre: who will own the canary dashboards and alerts?

sam_infra: i'll own instrumentation + Grafana panels. mina_billing, can you validate invoice previews for canary tenants?

mina_billing: yep i'll run parallel ledger ingest for canary tenants and compare preview -> final deltas. will post a short report in this thread after first 2 hours.

carlos_api: one more: add a debug mode header `x-metering-debug=true` that when present causes the ingest shim to echo `dedupe_basis` into the raw event for easier debugging during rollout. keep it off in prod.

tasha_product: thanks everyone. i'll draft a short RFC and a screenshot mock for the console badge. please add notes there and link back.

sam_infra: thanks all. tracking follow-ups: 1) shim accepts x-client-retry-of + debug header, 2) fingerprint async enrichment for small tenants, sync for heavy tenants, 3) aggregator single-source sampling, 4) console badge + provenance column, 5) canary dashboard + runbook.

mina_billing: report: after 2h canary the preview vs final delta is 1.05 for tenant small-a, 1.12 for medium-b, 1.08 for big-c. looks promising. will run overnight.

rachel_sre: good first pass. close loop tomorrow AM once the extended canary finishes. :white_check_mark:
